text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I apologize for making you help out with this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We overhauled every purchasing category this time around, after all.
The ordering scope must be quite extensive and exhausting.
I know I asked, but please don't overexert yourself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...No problem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Mission Accomplished.
Purchase orders... all... compiled.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...! You're finished already?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. As expected, your work is sharp and remarkably capable.
You've truly been a massive help. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAHH!! A B-U-G----!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-dono!! I beg of you!
Exterminate it this instant, pleaaase!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Gah! Wait, Kris S-dono!
Is that... a stink bug, by chance...?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you must not crush it!
Those fiends release a lethal stench whenever they sense danger!
Anything... but that...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Yet if we cannot strike it, we are checkmated—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Wait, wh-what, what are you doing...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, why are you crafting a plastic bottle right now?!
The stink bug is flying all over the place!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...A capture device. 
With this... I capture it!

(—Bzzzzzzzz... *land*.
—*Scoop*, —*plop*)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Eh...? D-Did you get it...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
NUOOOOOH, WELL DONE!! There's no smell at all!
That contraption is incredible?! Are you a genius?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No... I just... looked it up.
...Apologies for... keeping you waiting.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nay, not at all, I am deeply indebted!
You saved me, Kris S-dono!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Simply executed... the mission.
...I will... release this outside... and return.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about this, having you help out with cleaning.
We've had a lot of crow trouble lately...
We're just short-handed.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Th-The crows again...
Can't we do something about this...?
Like driving them away...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right? But still...
Shooing them away too harshly kinda makes me feel bad for them...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Crows are really smart, right?
I'd like to figure out a way to... somehow split territories and coexist with them, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Kris S.
Sorry to ask, but including all that, could you help us out with crow countermeasures?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Coexistence.
...Acknowledged. ...I will execute... the mission.

One weekend morning,
I happened to be passing near the dorms
on business with <chrname>, when...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Squadron Two, about face!

text_block_list.name: Flock of Crows
text_block_list.text: Caw caw! KAAAH!

...For some reason, Symboli Kris S was barking
military-style commands at the crows.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Crow... training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
To peacefully... protect dorm life... from crow harm... and coexist.
...I accepted... the request.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So... it will take... time, but...
I will certainly... carry it out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So... it will take... time, but...
I will certainly... carry it out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...No. Still... immature.
All units, attention! Salute!

text_block_list.name: Flock of Crows
text_block_list.text: Caw!

The flock of crows gradually obeyed Symboli Kris S's commands...
I witnessed something truly extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
HishiAma... said it.
Crows are... smart.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So... we can surely... understand each other.

It seemed she believed that with genuine sincerity in training,
she could reach an understanding even with crows.
Witnessing her pure heart was quite heartwarming.
